about: Spec 15.5. Slugs are OpenRouter model ids; verify each against GET /api/v1/models before enabling the cloud. Prices are USD per million tokens (input / output) as listed by the pricing aggregators on 2026-10-10 and only feed the pre-flight spend estimate (converted at ModelsConfig.INR_PER_USD); the ledger records the cost OpenRouter reports and which slug answered, so swapping a model is an edit of this file. Caps are INR per job and per calendar month, per role.
